# RasiVani

> RasiVani (https://rasivani.com) is a free Vedic astrology website for Indian families, in 10 languages: English (en), हिन्दी (hi), தமிழ் (ta), తెలుగు (te), ಕನ್ನಡ (kn), മലയാളം (ml), मराठी (mr), বাংলা (bn), ગુજરાતી (gu), ଓଡ଼ିଆ (or). It makes a jathagam / janam kundli (birth chart), checks marriage porutham (10 poruthams), shows the daily panchangam with Rahu kalam, and publishes a fresh rasi palan (daily horoscope) for all 12 rasis every day at 00:05 IST.

Calculations use the sidereal zodiac with Lahiri (Chitrapaksha) ayanamsa, Vimshottari dasha and the ten South Indian poruthams. Birth details are processed in the visitor's browser and are never stored. Astrology is presented as cultural tradition, not as medical, financial or legal advice.
